name: Monkey Arena [CLASSIC]
desc:
Welcome to Monkey Arena! In this adventure, you're an ape who grows by eating bananas and battling other apes. Outsmart your rivals, climb the leaderboards, and become the jungle's top ape. Ready to eat, fight, and dominate? Join Monkey Arena now!

👍 Make sure to like and favorite for updates! ⭐

👟  If you sprint (SHIFT / RIGHT BUTTON ON MOBILE) you will lose your level progressively, so be careful  👟

🥊 You can deal damage to any level ape with "LIGHT ATTACK" 🥊

👊🏻 If your level is higher than the other ape, you can instantly annihilate other apes with "HEAVY ATTACK" 👊🏻

🪝 !! Press "F" to grapple !! 🪝


Developed by Vojii Games

scripts.title: Instant Max Level OP
scripts.script:
-- By arsyny1x 
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local Player = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = Player.Character or Player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local Humaniod = Character:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
local HumaniodRootPart = Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")

local Setting = {
    BananaSlider = 20000,
}

Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(Newchar)
    local Char = Newchar
    Character = Char
    Humaniod = Char:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
    HumaniodRootPart = Char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end)

local ReGui = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/depthso/Dear-ReGui/refs/heads/main/ReGui.lua'))()

local Window = ReGui:TabsWindow({
	Title = "arsyny1x",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 230),
    Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
})

local MainTab = Window:CreateTab({Name="Main"})
local PlayersTab = Window:CreateTab({Name="Player"})

local BananaSlider = MainTab:SliderInt({
Label = "Banana",
Value = Setting.BananaSlider,
Minimum = 1,
Maximum = 100000,
})

local Button = MainTab:Button({
	Text = "Get Banana",
	Callback = function(self)
		print("Hello world!",BananaSlider.Value)
        local Banana = workspace.Prefabs:FindFirstChild("Banana")
        if Banana then
            Banana.bananaValue.Value = BananaSlider.Value or Setting.BananaSlider
            task.wait(.1)
            Banana.CFrame = HumaniodRootPart.CFrame
            HumaniodRootPart.CFrame = HumaniodRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,30,0) 
        end
	end
})

local selectedPlayer = MainTab:Combo({
	Label = "Selected Players",
	Items = {},
    Callback = function(self,Value)
        shared.SelectPlayer = Value
    end
})

local RefreshPlayers =MainTab:Button({
    Text = "Refresh Players",
    Callback = function(self)
        local players = {}
        for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do 
            if p ~= Player then 
                table.insert(players,p.Name)
                selectedPlayer.Items = players
            end
        end
    end
})

local GrabSelectedPlayer = MainTab:Button({
    Text = "Grab Selected Player",
    Callback = function(self)
        local Sp = workspace[shared.SelectPlayer]
        HumaniodRootPart.CFrame = Sp.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,30,30)
        task.wait(.25)
        fireproximityprompt(Sp.GrabProximity)
    end
})

local KillSelectedPlayer = MainTab:Button({
    Text = "Kill Selected Player",
    Callback = function(self)
        local Sp = workspace[shared.SelectPlayer]
        local humaniod = Sp:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
        repeat 
            HumaniodRootPart.CFrame = Sp.PrimaryPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,30,30)
            game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PlayerEvents"):WaitForChild("PlayerAttack"):FireServer()
            task.wait()
        until humaniod.Health <= 0 
    end
})

local KillHighestLevelPlayer = MainTab:Button({
    Text = "Kill Highest Level Player",
    Callback = function(self)
        local higestlevel = -math.huge
        local TargetHum 
        pcall(function()
            for _, p in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
                if p ~= Player then
                    local Char = p.Character
                    if not Char then continue end
                    local Currentlevel = tonumber(p.stats.CurBanana.Value)

                    if Currentlevel >= higestlevel then
                        higestlevel = Currentlevel
                        TargetHum = p.Character
                    end 
                end
            end
            local humaniod = TargetHum:WaitForChild("Humanoid")
            repeat 
                HumaniodRootPart.CFrame = TargetHum.HumanoidRootPart.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,30,30)
                game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):WaitForChild("PlayerEvents"):WaitForChild("PlayerAttack"):FireServer()
                task.wait()
            until humaniod.Health <= 0 
        end)
    end
})

local WalkSpeed = PlayersTab:SliderInt({
    Label = "WalkSpeed",
    Value = 16,
    Minimum = 16,
    Maximum = 300
})

local ApplyWalkSpeed = PlayersTab:Button({
    Text = "Apply WalkSpeed",
    Callback = function(self,Value)
        if Humaniod.WalkSpeed ~= WalkSpeed.Value then
            Humaniod.WalkSpeed = WalkSpeed.Value
        end

        Humaniod:GetPropertyChangedSignal("WalkSpeed"):Connect(function()
            Humaniod.WalkSpeed = WalkSpeed.Value
        end)
    end
})
